cohort.inclusion: All three cases declared before this primary-source validation are retained. They were already seen by developers; this is not an unseen frozen forecast cohort.

horizon.rule: Classify dated reports of 2025 activity. Later events remain separate; search is not an exhaustive horizon-wide outcome census.

input.metadata_caution: Report/meeting dates, PDF creation and current Last-Modified are provenance clues, not proof of public availability on that date.
input.budget_semantics: Budget proposal in a review report; not a procurement estimate, award amount, or verified final project appropriation.

previous_replay.change: v10 handles formfeed section boundaries; the previously missing two-site remodeling programme now appears. This is a code-development comparison on an already-seen source, not new independent validation.

cases.match_scope: Two-site programme, including supervision; individual building/trade tenders are components, not the whole programme.

evidence.fact: Official library notice announces Segok complex remodeling 2025-09-01 to 2025-11-30, with restroom works 2025-09-22 to 2025-11-21.
evidence.proves: Work announcement for Segok component only.
evidence.does_not_prove: Tender publication, award, actual commencement, completion, or programme expenditure.

evidence.fact: Official library notice announces Sinsa complex floors 5 and 6 remodeling. Current amended content gives works 2025-09-29 to 2025-12-31 and closure through 2026-01-02.
evidence.proves: Official announcement covers the second site and identifies its floors.
evidence.does_not_prove: Current amended schedule was already public on 2025-07-21; actual completion or tender identity.

evidence.fact: Sinsa resident center announces reopening of its fifth-floor library on 2026-01-05 at 10:00. The original poster was visually read.
evidence.proves: A separate official reopening announcement consistent with the earlier closure.
evidence.does_not_prove: Actual reopening, completion of all floors or trades, procurement identity, or completed implementation within 2025.

cases.match_scope: Ilwon1/Daecheong Park residential streets only; 713 lights is the three-area total, not the target quantity.

evidence.fact: District reports 287 smart security lights installed in Ilwon1, among 713 newly installed across Ilwon1, Sinsa and Samsung2; 3,209 total operating district-wide.
evidence.proves: Official report of target-area implementation during 2025.
evidence.does_not_prove: Original tender ID/date, contracted spend, exact completion day, or causal forecast skill.

forecast_metrics.reason: No original primary tender records, unverified historical input availability, incomplete outcome census, and non-blind retrospective selection prevent forecast scoring.

limitations: No complete municipal/G2B tender or award register was retrieved.
Contract Seoul's current robots excludes contract and order-plan paths; those paths were not automated after discovering the prohibition.
G2B direct-link retrieval and robots retrieval were unavailable (gateway/timeouts); no evasion or alternate blocked path was used.
District notice title searches are bounded queries, not exhaustive searches of attachments, alternate names or contract systems.
Secondary tender indexes remain candidate discovery, not primary outcome evidence; their dates/amounts are unverified reports.
Programmes can split into sites, construction trades, materials and supervision. No sum of discovered components is claimed to exhaust the programme.
A planned work or reopening notice is not a completion certificate. A later reopening event is outside the 2025 target year.
Source report does not prove final adopted line-item amounts; the overall budget bill was modified before approval.
